## Problem and scope

Describe the concrete problem and expected behavior. Link the authoritative
contract or parent issue, and identify the owning repository and affected files
or interfaces.

## Exclusions

State what this change does not cover. Keep MailLens within its approved
Windows/OpenCode, Classic Outlook and read-only boundary.

## Dependencies and compatibility

Link real prerequisites and related implementations. Identify overlapping files,
existing callers or persisted formats, and any migration or rollback requirements.
Write "None" if there are no dependencies.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe an observable outcome and its evidence.

## Verification plan and evidence

List actual commands/scenarios, expected assertions, environment and resource
requirements. Record results, failed or skipped checks, and evidence links as they
become available. Include relevant failure/cancellation, security and concurrency
behavior. Distinguish synthetic checks from real Windows/Outlook evidence.

Use only synthetic data. Never include live mail, addresses, mailbox/item IDs,
credentials or raw query results here or in linked public logs.
